reason: It hits my exact pain, I'll give you that, but it's one operator selling me a 3-week fix and I've been burned by consultants before. For 9.500 EUR I'd rather rebuild my own demo than hand it to someone I can't vouch for.
objection: A single person, no named clients or numbers, asking 9.500 EUR up front with nothing tying their fee to whether my close rate actually moves.
would_change_my_mind: Concrete proof - two or three seed/Series A enterprise founders in logistics or supply chain who closed deals after this, ideally with some of the fee tied to results.
